content.rendered:
The Archer Glen Site Council Survey for parents for the 2017-2018 school year will be available on Thursday, May 3rd at 7:30 am until Tuesday, May 8th at 12:00 pm. Please fill out the survey one time per family. The first page answers school-wide questions, then you will be prompted to answer questions based upon the grade levels of your children. Your child’s teacher will have a device prepared for you to take this survey at Archer Glen during conference time. It is best to take the survey after your last conference since some questions pertain to the spring conference itself. However, you can take the survey at your home until it closes on Tuesday.  Please click on the SURVEY link to begin.

Parents, thank you for taking this survey. Your feedback is invaluable to us.
